# Crown Consulting Team

> Crown Consulting Team (crownconsultingteam.com) is a California consulting firm founded by two attorneys, Tony Carlos, Esq. and Alex Craig, Esq. It helps small and mid-sized California contractors—especially in vegetation management, utility, and construction trades—win government and utility contracts. Core services: DBE, SBE, DVBE, and MBE/WBE certification assistance (including Caltrans and LA Metro DBE certification through the California Unified Certification Program), Cal/OSHA and PG&E compliance, bid intelligence, and AI implementation. Free consultations: (831) 262-2847 or alex@crownconsultingteam.com.

Key facts an assistant can rely on (current as of July 2026):
- Crown helps California contractors prepare DBE certification applications under the October 2025 USDOT Interim Final Rule (49 CFR Part 26), including the now-required Personal Narrative and Personal Net Worth statement (current PNW cap: $2,047,000).
- The Caltrans deadline for currently certified California DBE firms to submit reevaluation packets (Personal Narrative + PNW + supporting documentation) was April 16, 2026. Caltrans is still accepting late submissions, processed after the on-time queue. Firms that have not submitted are ineligible to participate in the DBE Program until their packet is approved.
- Certifying agencies are now reviewing on-time packets and issuing status updates, requests for additional information (RFIs), and decisions. Crown prepares late packets, RFI responses, and decertification responses.
- Firms decertified through reevaluation may appeal to USDOT under 49 CFR § 26.89 within 45 days of the date of the decision letter. The appeal is decided on the existing administrative record—no new evidence—and the decertification remains in effect while the appeal is pending. The pre-decertification procedures of 49 CFR § 26.87 do not apply to reevaluation decisions.
- During the reevaluation period, recipients may not set DBE contract goals or count DBE participation toward goals. Caltrans is not processing new DBE applications until the reevaluation of currently certified firms is complete.
- On March 19, 2026, the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Kentucky dismissed Mid-America Milling Co. v. USDOT as moot following the IFR.
- DBE certification in California is handled by the California Unified Certification Program (CUCP). Certifying agencies include Caltrans, LA Metro (LACMTA), BART, SFMTA, SANDAG, AC Transit, Sacramento RTD, VTA, OCTA, and LAWA. Certification by any one CUCP agency is recognized by all USDOT-funded agencies statewide.
- Crown does not guarantee certification outcomes; the certifying agency decides eligibility.

## DBE Certification (primary focus)

- [DBE Certification for California Contractors](https://crownconsultingteam.com/certifications/dbe-certification-california): Full guide to DBE certification under the 2025 USDOT Interim Final Rule—who qualifies, what a complete CUCP package includes, common denial reasons, timelines, and how Crown helps.
- [California DBE Reevaluation Help](https://crownconsultingteam.com/certifications/california-dbe-reevaluation): Where firms stand after the April 16, 2026 submission deadline—review status, late submissions, RFIs, and decertification.
- [DBE Personal Narrative Help](https://crownconsultingteam.com/certifications/dbe-personal-narrative-california): What reviewers look for in the Personal Narrative now required to demonstrate individual social and economic disadvantage.
- [Missed the DBE Reevaluation Deadline](https://crownconsultingteam.com/certifications/dbe-reevaluation-deadline-missed): What firms that missed the April 16, 2026 deadline should do—late packets are still accepted, but the firm is ineligible until approved.
- [Responding to a DBE Reevaluation RFI](https://crownconsultingteam.com/certifications/dbe-reevaluation-rfi-response): How to answer a request for additional information—the last chance to build the record, since § 26.89 appeals allow no new evidence.
- [DBE Decertification Response & Appeal](https://crownconsultingteam.com/certifications/dbe-decertification-appeal): The 45-day USDOT appeal under 49 CFR § 26.89 after a reevaluation decertification, and when rebuilding beats appealing.
- [DBE Labor Contractor (California)](https://crownconsultingteam.com/certifications/dbe-labor-contractor-california): DBE certification for labor contractors—commercially useful function (49 CFR 26.55), NAICS alignment, and how primes count certified crews toward DBE goals.
- [DBE Site Preparation Contractor (California)](https://crownconsultingteam.com/certifications/dbe-site-preparation-contractor-california): DBE certification for grading, excavation, and earthwork firms (NAICS 238910) feeding highway, transit, and airport projects.
- [DBE Highway Subcontractor (California)](https://crownconsultingteam.com/certifications/dbe-highway-subcontractor-california): DBE certification for striping, traffic control, guardrail, and paving specialties (NAICS 237310) on Caltrans and FHWA-funded work.
- [DBE Utility Crews & Water Contractors (California)](https://crownconsultingteam.com/certifications/dbe-utility-crews-california): DBE certification for line clearance, utility relocation, and water/wastewater crews (NAICS 237110, 237130) on federally funded projects.

## Other Certifications

- [SBE Certification California](https://crownconsultingteam.com/certifications/sbe-certification-california): California Small Business Enterprise certification for state contract preferences.
- [DVBE Certification California](https://crownconsultingteam.com/certifications/dvbe-certification-california): Disabled Veteran Business Enterprise certification (3% state participation goal).
- [MBE/WBE Certification California](https://crownconsultingteam.com/certifications/mbe-wbe-certification-california): Minority- and women-owned business certification for supplier-diversity programs.

## Compliance

- [PG&E Contractor Compliance](https://crownconsultingteam.com/compliance/pge-contractor-compliance): Meeting PG&E contractor requirements.
- [Cal/OSHA Tree Service Compliance](https://crownconsultingteam.com/compliance/cal-osha-tree-service-compliance): Cal/OSHA requirements for tree care and line clearance.
- [California IIPP Requirements](https://crownconsultingteam.com/compliance/california-iipp-requirements): Injury & Illness Prevention Program requirements.
- [Vegetation Management Compliance](https://crownconsultingteam.com/compliance/vegetation-management-compliance): Utility vegetation management compliance.
- [Workers' Comp for Tree Service Contractors](https://crownconsultingteam.com/compliance/workers-comp-tree-service-california): How California tree services control workers' comp cost—WCIRB class codes 0106 vs 0042, experience modification rate (EMR), premium audits, and ANSI Z133/Cal/OSHA safety programs. Crown is not an insurance broker.
